notes.title: September 11 2025 Update v1.4.6
notes.content:
Hi there. We're interrupting our usually scheduled programming to bring you something of an emergency patch to fix some flickering issues introduced with the latest Windows 10 and 11 updates.

Notable Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed flickering issue on Windows
 - The change made to Windows as part of their September 2025 update that caused the flickering retroactively affects ALL previous versions of Crescent Roll, unfortunately. We highly recommend updating. Not that there's really much of a reason to stay on any of the older versions anyway, but you know.
[*] Miscellaneous hangs relating to malformed and incomplete mods fixed
[*] Core Mod File Browser added in the Mod => Docs sub-menu
 - Use it to pull any of the resources used by the game as a template for your own mods. Be sure to read the license agreement for re-distributing assets though, please.
[/list]

Alright, that wraps it up. Please let us know if anyone hits any issues, and we'll try to patch those up asap. And hopefully our games stop suddenly becoming broken by obscure OS changes. But ya know - that's life or something, I guess. Until next time.

notes.title: August 18 2025 Update v1.4.5
notes.content:
Well, technically I guess we didn't [i]have[/i] to push this update. But it would just be sitting there out on the counter. And then it would get stale. And nobody likes stale stuff.

Notable Changes:
[list]
[*] New preliminary Mod API Interactive Doc available under Options => Mods
 - Even if you don't ever plan on making your own mod, you should look - it's very fancy. Marvel at its beauty.
 - The API is considered 'public beta' at this point, which means that installing and using mods is completely 100% safe and supported moving forward with no chance of it harming save data, but any mods made with this specific v1.4.5 API may not be able to be run with future versions v1.5 and beyond without additional modification from the original creator.
[*] A bunch of internal improvements for said mod support, as well as other upcoming v1.5 features.
[*] Slight reduction in Loading times.
[/list]

Our office will be closed next week, so you know - just slip the envelope under the door, please.
And with that, I'm outta here.

notes.title: August 11 2025 Update v1.4.4
notes.content:
I really don't mind the heat. But honestly, I could do without having to cut the grass every week.
What? Oh yeah, patch notes.

Notable Changes:
[list]
[*] Preliminary Mods info menu available under Options to help some community members
  - Mod API is still considered in Beta state, and certain parts may not be forward-compatible
[*] Fixed issue where the 4th of July stages would not load correctly in certain cases
[*] Fixed issue with green flash on sluggish GPUs
[*] More under-the-hood adjustments in preparation for v1.5
[/list]

Let us know if you hit any bugs, as always.
And with that, peace out.

notes.title: August 4 2025 Update v1.4.3
notes.content:
First day of August and the local grocery store has already started sticking out Halloween candy. Don't worry - we'll resist the urge and hold the line here. 

Notable Changes:
[list]
[*] New low-gravity Marshmallow Challenges.
[*] 2 new Hats added into the mix. 
[*] More tweaks to ease the suffering in Challenge Mode:
  - Streak requirements for earning hearts have been lowered
  - Several extremely difficult challenge sets have been replaced
  - The time granted for each stage now takes the types of modifiers into account properly
  - Any changes to the stage now show up during the intro animation before game play begins
[*] Initial loading is significantly faster, and should no longer freeze the UI for most machines
[*] The game should now show the correct name and icon in the Windows Volume Mixer
[/list]

Alright. Hit us up if you hit any other issues, and we'll patch those up real quick. 'Till next week - toodles.

notes.content:

notes.title: The Ruthless Capitalism Update
notes.content:
[p]It's a hot one out there. And in here too - our [strike]oven[/strike] PC has been on non-stop for the past two months getting this update ready. And it's a [i]spicy[/i] one:[/p][p][/p][h1]Show your skill in Challenge Mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480591/66095babf9ce437e01a7df3da970412e45b261e5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480591/83ffe2fc318a1c5c3f10cbb2c48e89d3ccab21f1.png"][/img][/h1][p]Standard offerings starting to feel stale? Introducing Challenge Mode! The clock is ticking down, and you have a never-ending stream of randomized special orders to fill with all kinds of strange effects. From shrinking your ball down to encasing it in jelly, each changes how you need to approach every stage. The longer you go, the more Dough you earn and the more coins get added to the stage, but the less time is restored and the more effects get piled on at once. How long can you hang on?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480591/9d7cd7b7485c35cb3e88a399ece85e7291cd70c4.png"][/img]We've got three packs hot and ready for everyone to try. You'll have to clear the base stages Vanilla first before you can give the spicier versions a shot, though - either clear them through the normal gameplay menu, or you can just click on the button to jump to a quick select.

Keep in mind that these flavors are a little experimental, and the kitchen is still in the process of tweaking them. The randomness and sheer number of combinations means you might hit certain setups that are significantly more difficult than others out of the blue, so if you get frustrated with potentially unwinnable situations or external factors ruining your run, this mode might not be for you.[/p][h1]
Cosmetics get an Overhaul[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480591/e2dca7369a325b5af425878685c1b092aa3b4d9b.png"][/img]Speaking of Dough, the cosmetics shop has been revamped. The number of items available has been doubled, and we now have this cool gumball machine thing to hand them out because I was definitely not having a really hard time figuring out what to price each individual item. All 3 modes also give out Dough, with big bonuses for getting new hearts, so play what you want and the cash will just roll in.

Don't worry - any existing cosmetics you bought before carry over, and you'll get some Dough for all of the Hearts that you've earned before this update, even if you've already spent them.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the game hanging when trying to start without a save file on certain machines[/p][/*][*][p]Oh yeah, it was like the 4th of July or something. Have 5 new levels and a Hamburger.[/p][/*][*][p]More Menu tweaks. You'll be getting more next update too. And the next one. And the next one.[/p][/*][/list][p]And that's it. As usual, please let us know if you've got any bugs that need squashing. See you sometime next month.[/p]

notes.title: June 6 2025 Update v1.3.2
notes.content:
Don't mind me - just doing a little bit of preliminary maintenance here before the big stuff shows up. 

Notable Changes:
[list]
[*] UI Fixes
 - Back Button on the Main Menu now shows the controller button. Not sure how we missed that one.
 - Steam Deck should size stuff like the Cookie Jar setup menu correctly now
[*] Performance Tweaks
- Stage Loading should no longer lag, and be significantly faster on most machines
- Main Menu especially should run consistently faster now, especially on Steam Deck
- [b]The initial game load will last a little bit longer now.[/b] We're working on getting that back down, but had to make a temporary tradeoff to get the rest of the game running more smoothly.
[/list]

Last chance to explicitly purchase specific in-game cosmetics with the Hearts earned on stages, for real this time. The next update is adding a lot of cosmetics, but switches over to a different in-game currency system and makes the unlocks mostly luck-dependent, You'll keep all your existing cosmetics, and be retroactively awarded Dough for your best stage times with no penalty on any Hearts spent, so might as well go nuts and nab what you want now.

notes.title: The Sweet Bee Update
notes.content:
The hazy days of Summer are soon upon us, and that means picnics. And picnics, means bees. And bees, means honey. And you keep honey in jars. See where we're going with this? Probably not.

[h1]Cookie Jar Mode get an Upgrade[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480591/820dc94195bc99ee640b974a4e55dc325fdfc003.png[/img]

A total of 10 individual Cookie Jar stages are now available! Merge the balls together for the ever-elusive king-sized snack in a variety of somewhat inconveniently-shaped-for-storage jars. Also, some of them might be a little sticky with honey. But the hearts earned here can be spent on cosmetics just like the ones in the Main Course mode, so aim for that high score!

Please note that a total of 10 recipes need to be cleared in the Main Course mode before Cookie Jar mode is unlocked. I mean, you've gotta bake 'em first. You can't stick Nothing in a cookie jar.

[h1]Get to New Stuff Faster[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480591/ff17fe01ec656311cbf14d53fffb408c351f323c.png[/img]

That extra three seconds of having to sit through the stage setup animation twice if you beat a stage and then just wanted to immediately move on to a different one was kind of annoying. So instead of giving up and finally making a normal results screen, we opted for a quick menu that pops up for those brief seconds that you can use to pick if you want to advance or retry. If the next stage hasn't been cleared, it'll default to moving on instead of retrying, but you can change it with a quick button press. There's still no penalty for failing or changing stage normally though, but now you can keep riding that flow just a little bit more efficiently.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The UI buttons now show for Keyboard and dynamically change when controllers change
[*] A new Hairstyle and Hat to celebrate... bees, I guess.
[*] Additional tweaks to reduce level loading times when playing all of them in a suite.
[*] Lots of internal stuff getting cleaned up to help with future content.
[/list]

As usual, if you happen to find any bugs (except for the bees) please let us know. We'll squash them for you right quick. 

See you guys next month.

notes.title: April 28 2025 Update v1.2.2
notes.content:
Greetings, Gourmands.

This week's levels are now hot and ready. Come and get 'em.

Notable Changes:
[list]
[*] The Level Select in-game now shows individual times and hearts earned
[*] 5 new Cordial Levels
[*] PlayStation 4 and 5 controllers now change colors based on the background. Neat.
[*] Significant re-organization for Menu systems under the hood
 - This should slightly improve memory consumption for the Main Menu
[*] Potential crash fixed when you have more than 4 controllers plugged in
[/list]

Another reminder that in the next major update in May, the cosmetics shop is going to change to switch to a capsule machine system, so the number of cosmetics is going to increase dramatically, but it will not be possible to directly pick which outfit you want. You will be granted the full amount of game currency that you would have earned over playing the game at the time of the switch, with nothing deducted from any of the purchases made with the current heart system, so we suggest grabbing the items that you specifically want now before the switchover occurs.

notes.title: April 21 2025 Update v1.2.1
notes.content:
Greetings, Gourmands.

In the excitement of the Steam Deck release last week, we seem to have forgotten to put out our Easter Specials. Have no fear, as you are now free to overdose on virtual chocolate and jelly beans. Or at least one shiny foil egg.

Notable Changes:
[list]
[*] Various internal tweaks and fixes
- Switching between Touch/Mouse and Controller modes should work more consistently
- The advice given on the Recipe Complete screen should change according to progress now
[*] 5 new Easter holiday levels, with a particularly difficult one at the tail end
[*] Some rather tacky bunny ears
[/list]

We'll also take this time to give a heads-up that the cosmetic shop will be changing in the next update to better facilitate a larger number of items. Anything that you buy now with the current system WILL remain unlocked, however. If you have something in particular you know you absolutely want to get now, you may want to spend the hearts to grab it before the next update sometime in May.

notes.title: Steam Deck Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Gourmands.

Spring is just about in full spring, so if you've got the fever to step out of the kitchen, we now have a to-go offering. That is- the Steam Deck port is now available.

notes.title: March 17 2025 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Gourmands.

We've been toiling away in the kitchen, and have our first serving of updates hot and ready on the way.

Notable additions:
[list]
[*] New seasonal St. Patrick Specials - Rum Ball courses
[*] Full Game Controller Support
 - Includes Gyro support for PlayStation and Nintendo Switch Pro controllers
 - Includes Touch Bar support for PlayStation controllers
[*] Fixed Cloud Saves not working correctly for certain account IDs
 - If you have played on multiple devices, the progress should automatically merge. You may need to re-equip cosmetics, however.
[/list]

If you want a peek behind the scenes, be sure to visit our development blog on [url=https://www.tumblr.com/16naughts]tumblr[/url] for weekly Friday updates on upcoming features, as well as some general development ramblings.

Next order: Steam Deck version. See you then! Hopefully very soon.

notes.title: Now Open for Business
notes.content:
Welcome everyone, to the grand opening of Crescent Roll! We hope it's as fun to play as it was making it.

We've got something of an early bird special going right now as the kitchen kicks fully into gear. Of course, a full menu is already available. However, expect some additional entrees to be added in the coming weeks as we learn the ropes, as well as a few things that needed just a little bit more time in the oven, like controller support, additional screen resolutions, and a native Steam Deck version.

So, take up a seat, and dig in! [i]Bon Appétit![/i]
